what: The finding of Issue #379 reproduced on today's origin/main, and the two ways it differs from the numbers the Issue quotes. No production code is touched at this checkpoint: the two guards below are added and are red, which is what «reproduced» means here.

base.howObtained: scripts/agent/take-task.ps1 -Issue 379 created C:\gamedev\_wt-379 off origin/main; the branch it made was renamed to fix/379-hover-neighbour. git rev-parse HEAD = ee2901ec2c9e8fcf46975e4c61f16b75e115b345

scene.howReproduced: WorldLabelLayoutTests.OwnerScene(tick) for the pure measurements; scripts/run-game.ps1 -Fixture baseline -Seed 20260729 -ScreenshotTicks 2380 for the frames.

theQuotedNumbersDoNotReproduce.claim: Issue #379 quotes review of PR #376: quiet frame «Ловчий, Сиплый, Секира, Гнилозуб, Долговязый» (5) against hovered (16,7) «Сиплый, Секира, Гнилозуб, Долговязый» (4), «Ловчий» going dark.
theQuotedNumbersDoNotReproduce.why: Those two frames were captured on the base of PR #376, which merged before PR #377 (fix of Issue #361, commit 3e82295). #377 made the damage jitter live, so the party that reaches tick 2380 of this journal is a different party: twelve raiders on the map instead of eleven, five captioned instead of six, and the crowd stands on (14,7) instead of (15,7). The shipped guards were re-pinned to those numbers in PR #377 itself (WorldLabelLayoutTests.Every_returning_raider_of_the_owners_scene_is_still_named: wave-4 row 5, 3).

todayHover16x7.reading: The cell the Issue names now holds the crew member «Дёготь» and no raider. Pointing at it costs nobody his name today — it adds two. The cell moved with the scene; the defect did not.

theQuotedNumbersDoNotReproduce.renderedFrameEqualsThePureLayout: Checked on three frames before relying on it: quiet, -HoverCell "15,7" and -SelectCell "15,7" each draw exactly the set WorldLabels.Of returns for the same focus with canonical cell centres. So the pure measurements below describe the frame the owner would see, not a fixture.

theDefectItselfReproduces.claim: A gesture that adds a sentence about one body takes a name away from another.
theDefectItselfReproduces.subject: «Сиплый», raider #20 on cell (14,7) — the one caption of the wave-4 frame whose second line the quiet map sheds.
theDefectItselfReproduces.mechanism: WorldLabelLayout.FirstAttempt exempts a focused label from the first pass (Issue #371), so «Сиплый» bids his whole caption — a sentence 103.7 reference pixels wide, four and a half tiles — before any neighbour has bid its name. That is the greedy order Issue #364 rejected with numbers, switched back on for one label.
theDefectItselfReproduces.notReachableFromTheCommandLine: This frame cannot be captured with -HoverCell: the flag reads WorldLabels.PointedAt, which answers a crowded cell with its first body — «Гнилозуб» for (14,7). There is no --hover-body-index counterpart of --select-body-index. Measured through the layout instead, which the paragraph above shows is the same answer.

guards.output: Не пройден!: не пройдено 2, пройдено 9, пропущено 0, всего 11

A_second_line_never_costs_a_neighbour_hi.verbatim: Assert.Equal() Failure: Collections differ / Expected: ["Raider#17", "Raider#18", "Raider#20"] / Actual: ["Raider#17", "Raider#20"]
A_second_line_never_costs_a_neighbour_hi.reading: Raider#18 is «Долговязый». The check compares the frame the game draws with the frame it would draw if no caption had a second line at all — same focus, same ranks, same order — so the difference it reports is exactly what the sentences cost.

The_body_under_the_cursor_is_offered_its.verbatim: Assert.Single() Failure: The collection contained 2 items / Collection: [Косой, волна 2 · достали (24,7)]
The_body_under_the_cursor_is_offered_its.reading: It states the second half of the rule — the focused label is the first one offered its sentence back once every name is down — and on the base commit the neighbour gets one too, because a label that bid two lines in the first pass leaves the second pass free for everybody else.

hoveringACrewMemberCostsTwoNames.measured: -HoverCell "15,7" (crew member «Тишина») at tick 2380: 2 labels against the quiet 3 — «Гнилозуб» and «Долговязый» both go dark, and «Сиплый» keeps his sentence.
hoveringACrewMemberCostsTwoNames.why: «Тишина DOWN» is a one-line label 79.2 reference pixels wide and it is served first because the cursor outranks everybody. It bids one line, so the two-pass rule is not broken — this is «приём 5» working exactly as declared in REFERENCES.md, on a corridor with no room. It is named here because the owner-visible symptom is the same one («имена вокруг курсора гаснут») and this change does not fix it.
hoveringACrewMemberCostsTwoNames.status: reported, not fixed: fixing it means changing which body gives way when the corridor is full, which is the show rule the Issue's non-goals forbid touching.

aSelectedRaiderIsNotFocusedInTheRunningG.measured: -SelectCell "17,7" -SelectBodyIndex 1 selects raider #24 «Хват Старший»: the feedback line says «(17,7): 2 of 2 standing here», and the frame shows no label over him, no selection ring and a generic CELL panel. Same at (14,7) index 3 («Сиплый»: the frame is the quiet frame) and at (25,7).
aSelectedRaiderIsNotFocusedInTheRunningG.expected: WorldLabels.Of with focus.Selected = Raider#24 returns four labels including his; the layout is not what is failing.
aSelectedRaiderIsNotFocusedInTheRunningG.alreadyVisibleInTheShippedEvidence: evidence/373-body-index.json records the same thing without naming it as a defect — «inspector: CELL (15, 7) — generic cell panel, not a creature panel», and evidence/373-body-index-3.png shows the selected raider «Секира» with no ring and no second line.
aSelectedRaiderIsNotFocusedInTheRunningG.status: reported, not fixed: the gap is in the adapter (src/DungeonFortress.Game/**), which Issue #379's partition names as somebody else's. It also means criterion 2 of this Issue is measured through the layout and not through a captured frame.
